|game_text='''Front side — Geonosis (Separatist Controlled)'''

'''Light Side:''' If you just initiated a Force drain (or won a battle) at a Geonosis site, 'conquer' (flip) Geonosis.

'''Dark Side:''' During battle here, you may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.

'''Back side — Geonosis (Republic Controlled)'''

'''Light Side:''' While you occupy with a [Republic] starship, your Jedi (and clones) at Geonosis sites are power +1.

'''Dark Side:''' If you just initiated a Force drain (or won a battle) at a Geonosis site, 'conquer' (flip) Geonosis.
